modeling.model module

modeling.model.get_model(num_classes: int, load_weights: bool = True)[source]

Create a Faster R-CNN model with a ResNet-50 FPN backbone.

Parameters:

  • num_classes – number of classes including background

  • load_weights – If True (default), load weights pre-trained on COCO. Set to False to skip loading weights for fast initialization.

Returns:

torch.nn.Module

Return type:

model
